author: TEDx Talks
description:
What does the reality of breast cancer survivorship look like once the treatment is over? As a medical oncologist, Dr. Mita Manna knows that clinical trials and genetic testing are transforming care and giving patients access to life-changing therapies once thought impossible. But what happens when individuals leave the clinic? This talk will go beyond the science and the advances in treatment, and instead home in on the human side of healing. By exploring the connection between mind, body and soul, Dr. Manna shows us how we can open up the conversation on cancer, define what true survivorship means, and move beyond the pink ribbon to create real change.  

Dr. Mita Manna (MD) is a Medical Oncologist at the Saskatoon Cancer Centre and associate professor within the Department of Oncology in the College of Medicine at the University of Saskatchewan (USask). She is the former Provincial Disease Site Lead for Breast Malignancies and Chair for the  Research Excellence and Active Leadershi
title: An oncologist's guide to thriving after breast cancer | Mita Manna | TEDxUniversityofSaskatchewan

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In an era where Gen Z are under pressure to be unique while AI flattens individuality, Tomi offered a refreshing and “disgustingly real” perspective: standing out isn’t about perfection, polish, or algorithms. It’s about discipline, consistency, and having the courage to show up fully as yourself - even when it’s uncomfortable.

His talk challenged the idea that success comes from shortcuts or performance. Instead, Tomi showed how embracing misfortune, asking the so-called “silly” questions, and committing to disciplined action can carve out genuine belonging in any room.

Tomi showed our audience:

- Why Gen Z are finding it harder than ever to be unique — and how to reclaim individuality in the age of AI.

- How misfortune and adversity can become a competitive advantage rather than a setback.

- Why consistency and discipline outperform talent\, trends\, and confidence over time.

- How being unapologetically yourself creates connection\, credibility\, and true belonging.

With hon
title: How real discipline creates belonging | Tomi Ilori | TEDxDublin Salon

author: TEDx Talks
description: What if the biggest decisions of your life have already happened and haven't happened at all? TEDx speaker Evan Shibu dives into the mind-bending world of quantum superposition. Using Schrödinger's famous cat as a guide, Evan explains how "simultaneous realities" aren't just for sci-fi movies. He challenges the audience to stop looking at life as a straight line and start seeing it as a web of infinite possibilities, where the only thing that creates "reality" is the moment we choose to look. Evan Shibu is a 15-year-old with a passion for Formula 1 (F1), guitar, cycling, and working out. He loves pushing his limits - whether on the road, in the gym, or exploring new interests. For him, it’s all about learning, growing, and having fun. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The Observer's Choice | Evan Shibu | TEDxGEMS Westminster School Sharjah

author: TEDx Talks
description: Si la historia de la Tierra fuera un libro de mil páginas, la humanidad aparecería en la última línea. Alberto nos invita a cambiar de escala para pensar el tiempo geológico, la historia del planeta y el lugar que ocupamos. Es paleontólogo de vertebrados, investigador del CONICET en la UBA y National Geographic Explorer. De origen italiano y con estudios en Italia, España y Argentina, se especializa en la megafauna sudamericana, con un foco muy particular: los perezosos gigantes. Su última publicación fue el “Auge y caída de los perezosos gigantes”, en la revista Science. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: La historia de la vida en 1000 páginas | Alberto Boscaini | TEDxRiodelaPlata

author: TEDx Talks
description: ¿Qué pasa cuando el dolor desarma el lenguaje? Cuando se trata de violencia vicaria, reconstruir la línea temporal de los hechos no es solo un procedimiento técnico: es una forma de comprender, recuperar la voz y comenzar un proceso de reparación. Raquel comparte cómo acompañar a víctimas a narrar su historia puede convertirse en una herramienta de supervivencia y reconstrucción. Desde 1991, su oficio es contar historias. Lo ha hecho en plazas, bibliotecas, teatros, colegios, capillas, desiertos, islas y montañas; con micrófono o a viva voz, ante cientos de personas o en petit comité. Ha dado cursos y conferencias a padres, docentes y estudiantes dentro y fuera de España, para imaginar, filosofar, experimentar y, sobre todo, rumiar cuentos. Es autora de varios libros, ha recorrido numerosos festivales, y forma parte de AEDA y de la asociación Libres de Violencia Vicaria. Además, dirige ciclos, da talleres y sigue creando nuevas formas de compartir la palabra. This talk was given at a
title: Cronología de la violencia vicaria | Raquel López Cascales | TEDxRiodelaPlata

author: TEDx Talks
description:
En un mundo que corre sin pausa, los sentidos son - a veces - una puerta a la memoria. Marcela explora cómo los sentidos nos permiten crear memorias, construir experiencias significativas, regular emociones y encontrar momentos de presencia auténtica en la vida diaria. Es Sommelier Internacional y presidenta de la Asociación Argentina de Sommeliers. Durante 8 años llevó el mundo del vino a la televisión en Cocineros Argentinos y hoy es Sommelier Ejecutiva en MAGO. 
Autora del libro CHIN CHIN y creadora de SPIRITU Aromas del Vino, el primer kit para entrenamiento de la capacidad sensorial olfativa especializado en el terruño argentino. 
Asesora a bodegas y restaurantes y diseña actividades, eventos y cursos que combinan el vino y la comunicación. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Detenerse a sentir es un acto de rebeldía | Marcela Rienzo | TEDxRiodelaPlata

author: TEDx Talks
description:
El tiempo no pasa igual para todos. Para las personas en situación de calle, los días pueden volverse eternos; para quienes pasan de largo, basta un segundo para cambiarlo todo. Malena reflexiona sobre la indiferencia y el poder de la acción colectiva. Porque salir de la calle no es un acto individual: requiere comunidad, acompañamiento y compromiso. Es cofundadora y presidenta de Multipolar, fundación que acompaña a personas en situación de calle para que puedan superar esa situación al conseguir trabajo.  Trabaja con  personas que viven en la calle y paradores, personas que salieron de consumo de paco o lo están intentando, personas migrantes, que salieron de la cárcel y mujeres víctimas de violencias.
Es Licenciada en Comunicación Social, fellow de Ashoka, y actualmente estudia Medicina en la Universidad Nacional de José C. Paz, con el objetivo de especializarse en psiquiatría y así aportar desde otro ángulo a las poblaciones con las que trabaja.
Llevó su experiencia a más de 27 pa
title: Nadie sale solo de la situación de calle | Malena Famá | TEDxRiodelaPlata

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Migrar no es solo cambiar de país: es reconstruir identidad, vínculos y sentido de pertenencia. A partir de una historia familiar atravesada por el exilio, Corina reflexiona sobre cómo la migración transforma nuestra relación con el tiempo, la memoria y el hogar. Es psicóloga y doctora en Psicología Social, especializada en integración social de grupos vulnerables. A lo largo de su carrera lideró programas para migrantes, refugiados, infancia en riesgo y personas con discapacidad en organizaciones como ACNUR, HIAS, AMIA, Taglit y la Universidad de Haifa.
Reconocida como Emprendedora Social por Ashoka, combina gestión, innovación social y comunicación con una mirada profundamente humana.
Es autora de Raíces en Movimiento, un libro sobre migración, prejuicio y distancia social. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Migración: un viaje que transforma la identidad | Corina Lang | TEDxRiodelaPlata

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Dr. William L. Blake explores what it means to teach and learn in a world increasingly shaped by artificial intelligence. As AI technologies rapidly enter classrooms, workplaces, and everyday life, educators face a new challenge. How do we prepare students for a future where machines can generate answers, analyze information, and even assist in creative work?

In this insightful talk, Dr. Blake encourages educators and learners to rethink the purpose of education in the age of intelligent tools. Rather than fearing artificial intelligence, he invites us to see it as an opportunity to deepen curiosity, strengthen critical thinking, and reshape how knowledge is explored and shared. The conversation shifts from simply using technology to understanding how human judgment, ethics, and creativity must guide its use.

title: Teaching in the age of AI | Dr. William L. Blake | TEDxMorgan State University

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Bu konuşma, sanat, ekoloji ve biyoteknoloji kesişiminde sürdürülebilirliği yeniden düşünmeye davet ediyor. Sürdürülebilirliğin yalnızca malzeme ve kaynak meselesi olmadığını; aynı zamanda toplumsal ilişkiler, cinsiyet eşitliği ve fırsat eşitliğiyle doğrudan bağlantılı olduğunu hatırlatıyor. Türkiye’de kadın sanatçı olmanın görünmeyen zorluklarından yola çıkarak, üretimin hem ekolojik hem de sosyal boyutlarını tartışıyor. Bireysel çabaların sınırlı kalabildiği bir dünyada, birlikte düşünmenin ve birlikte hareket etmenin dönüştürücü gücüne dikkat çekiyor. Amaç, sanatın açtığı düşünme alanı üzerinden daha adil ve sürdürülebilir bir gelecek için yeni olasılıkları görünür kılmak. Nergiz Yeşil, sanat pratiğini toplumsal hafıza, kadın temsili ve kültürel dönüşüm temaları etrafında şekillendiren bir sanatçıdır. Üretimlerinde geleneksel anlatı biçimleri ile çağdaş ifade araçlarını bir araya getirerek, bireysel hikâyeler ile kolektif deneyim arasında köprü kurar.

title: Aman,Dünyayı Ben Mi Kurtaracağım-Sanat Mı Kurtaracak? | Nergiz Yeşil | TEDxYildizTechnicalUniversity

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Why do so many people minimize their own pain by saying, “It wasn’t that bad”?

In this honest and reflective talk, Niaomi S. MoShier explores the ways people often downplay difficult experiences in order to move forward, protect others, or avoid confronting deeper emotional wounds. While these words may seem harmless, they can quietly dismiss the impact that certain moments have had on our lives.

Through thoughtful storytelling and personal insight, Niaomi invites the audience to reconsider how we process hardship, trauma, and resilience. She highlights the importance of acknowledging our experiences with honesty rather than minimizing them, and how doing so can become a powerful step toward growth and healing.

This talk challenges listeners to recognize that strength does not come from pretending something did not hurt. Real strength comes from understanding our experiences, giving them the space they deserve, and allowing ourselves the opportunity to learn and grow from them.

title: 'It Wasn't That Bad' | Niaomi S. MoShier | TEDxMorgan State University

author: TEDx Talks
description:
The Age of AI and Human Re-invention: How Physical AI Will Remake Civilization confronts
a truth most AI conversations avoid. Intelligence is no longer advising human decisions. It
is beginning to act in the physical world. From hospitals and factories to cities and
infrastructure, embodied intelligence is reshaping how civilization functions. This talk
rejects both fear-driven narratives and simplistic techno-optimism, arguing instead that
Physical AI forces a more uncomfortable question: not what machines will replace, but
what humans must now become. Drawing on real-world deployments and global policy
experience, Senthil makes a bold case that the defining challenge of this era is not
technological capability, but humanity’s ability to govern intelligence with responsibility,
restraint, and purpose. Senthil M. Kumar is a globally recognized technology leader shaping the next era of artificial
intelligence. As CTO of Slate Technologies, he pioneers Physical and Agentic AI systems

title: How physical AI will remake civilization | Senthil Kumar | TEDxBVRIT Hyderabad

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Why do so many people find themselves awake at 2 a.m., overwhelmed by thoughts and silent struggles? This talk explores the hidden emotional battles people face during their most vulnerable moments and how understanding these struggles can lead to healing and resilience.

 Aishwarya Yadav is a filmmaker, storyteller, and multidisciplinary entrepreneur working at the intersection of creativity, neuroscience, and mental wellness. Trained at the New York Film Academy, she has produced impactful films and digital projects that explore human psychology, social relevance, and emotional depth, using storytelling as a tool for transformation. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The Intelligence We Forgot To Measure | Aishwarya Yadav | TEDxSinhgad COE

author: TEDx Talks
description: What does it mean to belong, make your mark, and find your place? Alexander Murta reflects on his personal journey, showing how moving across the world helped him build resilience and patience—qualities essential for discovering where you truly fit in and how to contribute meaningfully to your community. Alexander Murta is a 13-year-old student from the USA and a speaker at the TEDx St. Peter’s International School Youth Event. He hopes to share his personal experience with bullying and how he found a sense of belonging in his community. Having faced exclusion in the past, Alexander is passionate about helping others navigate similar challenges and offering reassurance that everyone matters and has a meaningful role to play. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The Path To Finding Where You Belong | Alexander Murta | TEDxSt Peters Intl School Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: Hydrofoils are becoming increasingly popular as modern technology advances. In his talk, Ivan Kruchinin delves into the physics behind hydrofoils and draws parallels to human connections. Just as the Alexei Ferry glides effortlessly over the water when its hydrofoils lift it, we too can move more smoothly through life when we work together and form strong, supportive connections. Ivan Kruchinin is an IB1 student at St. Peter’s International School and a speaker at the TEDx Youth Event. Born in Russia, he moved to Portugal in 2023, bringing a fresh international perspective to his new community. Passionate about sailing, biking, and competitive swimming, Ivan is taking part in the event to challenge himself and hopes that sharing his story will inspire others to take risks and push their own boundaries. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Flying Over Water | Ivan Kruchinin | TEDxSt Peters Intl School Youth
